Read biblically grounded and theologically informed reflections on various topics, all rooted in a confessionally Calvinistic commitment to Scripture. Here you will find a wide range of articles covering a number of topics and pertinent issues in our day. Read Articles
Access longer academic articles carefully researched to address the full range of theological disciplines, all from a Baptist and confessionally Calvinistic perspective. Read the Journal

Add books to your library consistent with the historic Calvinistic Baptist tradition that promote health and life in local churches. Founders Press publishes books focusing on systematic, historical, pastoral, and practical theology. Visit the Store

IOPT is the training institute of Founders Ministries and was established to help equip pastors and Christian leaders to wield the sword of the Spirit effectively in the world which God has created. Visit the Institute
Use the Founders Church Search tool to find a gospel-preaching, Christ-exalting, and biblically grounded church near you. Find a Church

Join us at an event in your area to be encouraged and equipped for the work of building up the church. Link arms with others as we gather to hear teaching, invest in relationships, and pray together. Conference Info
Use weekly Bible studies to help you study God’s word deeper, together with friends or in your own time of study. Find a Bible Study
The Sword & The Trowel is the weekly Founders Ministries podcast with Tom Ascol and Graham Gunden. New episodes every Tuesday. Listen to Podcasts

The inerrant Word sits encased in glass on the mantel, well-lit and plenty sharp. But it is time for pastors to lay hold of that sword and employ it in the battle as God commands. Doing so is costly. Doing so hurts. Doing so is dangerous. And courage is required. Founders Media
